description: Indian High Court judgments and final orders from the eCourts judgment portal (via the public 'Indian High Court Judgments' AWS Open Data mirror, 25 High Courts, 1950-2026): case title, judges, CNR, registration and decision dates, disposal nature, opening text and PDF link. List a court's judgments for a decision year (CNR order, paged) or look up a CNR. Mirror is updated about quarterly (CC-BY-4.0, Dattam Labs); not live case status. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

cnr.description: Optional 16-character CNR, e.g. DLHC010000012026 (decision year still required)

court.description: Court code (e.g. 7_26) or part of the name (Delhi, Bombay, Madras, Allahabad...)

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous answer, for the next page
